name: Etsy Search & Shop Sales MCP
description: Etsy search scraper and Etsy shop sales MCP for CRMs, dashboards, and AI assistants: live Etsy search listing rows (title, price, shop, badges, rank) + shop sales counters (history/breakout). Hosted remote MCP on Apify's gateway, plus an open-source Node.js stdio proxy in this repo. Wraps publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper + publicrecords/etsy-shop-velocity.
